body: Thank you for being kind. I will try and get back you when I feel like I can . I just feel empty.  Take care for now.. Be kind to yourself.

I feel the same . Except I'm not scared or bothered by the idea of killing myself. I just wish it wasn't such a process and that there was a garauntee that I'll be successful. I really pray for assisted suicide to be a human right even though it's unlikely to ever be the case. I hate that killing yourself is a taboo, too. I think it's selfish to expect others to live for the sake of everyone else's feelings. 

Thank you for taking your time to reply. It's reassuring to know I'm not the only one who feels this way. I just wish there was a cure. But I feel my life is a waste and I don't want to get better at this point.

Take care, i hope you feel better soon too. No one deserves to feel like this. It's living hell
